Package neqsim.process.equipment.valve

Class SafetyReliefValve

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.SimulationBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.ProcessEquipmentBaseClass
neqsim.process.equipment.TwoPortEquipment
neqsim.process.equipment.valve.ThrottlingValve
neqsim.process.equipment.valve.SafetyReliefValve
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable, AutoSizeable, TransientStateParticipant<ThrottlingValve.TransientState>, CapacityConstrainedEquipment, ProcessEquipmentInterface, TwoPortInterface, ValveInterface, ProcessElementInterface, SimulationInterface, NamedInterface, LegacyLoadRepairable
public class SafetyReliefValve extends ThrottlingValve
Safety/Relief Valve built on top of ThrottlingValve.

Features: - Set pressure, overpressure (relieving threshold), blowdown (reseat). - Opening laws: SNAP (pop) or MODULATING, with hysteresis. - Backpressure de-rating: Conventional, Balanced Bellows, Pilot Modulating. - Transient anti-chatter: first-order inertia, min open/close dwell, lift rate limit. Assumptions: - Pressures in bar(a) as typically used in NeqSim SystemInterface. - Cv mapping is linear w.r.t. opening; replace with vendor lift curve if available.

SNAP now commands opening at set pressure and retains demand until reseat. MODULATING uses unlatched set-to-full and latched reseat-to-full linear curves. These are synthetic pressure/lift laws, not vendor certified lift or rated-capacity curves. UUID and convenience entry points share the same implementation; lift is applied once by the configured parent valve characteristic.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

    • runTransient

      public void runTransient(double dt, UUID id)
      Advances self-acting lift once per non-null physical UUID, then reevaluates native Cv hydraulics.

      Zero dt reevaluates hydraulics only. A repeated UUID does not advance lift, latch, dwell, counters or response time, even if the supplied dt differs. Negative/nonfinite dt is rejected before mutation. This is not whole-call transactional rollback; use the owned snapshot plus independent connected stream snapshots for rejected physical trials.

      Specified by:
      runTransient in interface SimulationInterface
      Overrides:
      runTransient in class ThrottlingValve
      Parameters:
      dt - finite nonnegative interval, seconds
      id - actual physical-step UUID; null preserves independent legacy-call advancement

    • readObject

      private void readObject(ObjectInputStream input) throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException
      Migrates UID1 legacy streams explicitly instead of interpreting absent motion state as a failed valve.

      Legacy streams retain their actual lift/latch/dwell and scalar settings. New response counters/time start a documented epoch, motion is available, the seating cutoff defaults to 1e-8, and parent Cv is normalized to the corrected single-lift basis. This is a model migration, not exact legacy numerical replay. Current-schema streams preserve their complete response state.

      Parameters:
      input - serialized native graph
      Throws:
      IOException - if the stream is invalid or has an unsupported schema
      ClassNotFoundException - if a referenced native class is unavailable
